_doc: How each media favourite is called. kie: market path per mode + where images go; openrouter: the OpenRouter model id (generic /api/v1/videos or /api/v1/images). prompt_style: how the economic model rewrites the user's request for this model.

wan-3.prompt_style: A vivid English video prompt: subject, action and motion, camera movement, setting, lighting, sound if relevant. Keep every requested element.
wan-3._note: Kie wan/3-0-video (docs.kie.ai/market/wan/3-0-video.md, 2026-10-14): 2-30 s, 480P/720P/1080P (default 1080P = 0.16 $/s, hence 720p), audio on by default, nsfw_checker off by default.

gpt-image-2-5-sunburst.prompt_style: A detailed English image prompt: main subject, setting/background, lighting, composition and camera framing, style and mood. Keep EVERY element the user asked for (the setting especially) and add nothing he would not want.

gpt-image-2-5-flare.prompt_style: A detailed English image prompt: subject, setting, lighting, composition, style. Keep every requested element.

seedance-2-5.prompt_style: An English shot-by-shot video prompt for Seedance: for each shot, framing, camera movement, action and timing; consistent characters; reference the attached reference image as the visual anchor. Keep every requested element.

minimax-h3.prompt_style: A vivid English video prompt: subject, action and motion, camera, setting, lighting, sound if relevant. Keep every requested element.

gemini-omni-flash-1-1.prompt_style: A natural English prompt for an authentic creator-style (UGC) video: who speaks, framing (selfie / face camera), setting, what is said, tone. Keep every requested element.

grok-imagine-video-1-5.prompt_style: A short English video prompt: subject, action, camera, setting.

suno.prompt_style: Suno style tags in English (genre, mood, instruments, tempo) — max 200 characters.
